commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: install quota tools =="
sudo -n dnf install -y quota xfsprogs >/tmp/dnf.log 2>&1 || (tail -50 /tmp/dnf.log; exit 1)
rpm -q quota xfsprogs

echo "== STEP 2: create datauser =="
sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash datauser
id datauser

echo "== STEP 3: create backing image file for dedicated XFS filesystem =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv
sudo -n fallocate -l 2G /var/lib/srv-data.img
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f -m crc=1,finobt=1 /var/lib/srv-data.img

echo "== STEP 4: mount point and fstab entry with project quota =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -f)
echo "using loop device: $LOOPDEV"
sudo -n losetup "$LOOPDEV" /var/lib/srv-data.img

# Use UUID for stable fstab entry
UUID=$(sudo -n blkid -s UUID -o value "$LOOPDEV")
echo "UUID=$UUID"

sudo -n cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak
grep -q '/srv/data' /etc/fstab || \
  echo "/var/lib/srv-data.img /srv/data xfs loop,pquota,prjquota 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

sudo -n losetup -d "$LOOPDEV"

echo "== STEP 5: mount via fstab =="
sudo -n mount /srv/data
findmnt /srv/data

echo "== STEP 6: ownership =="
sudo -n chown datauser:datauser /srv/data
ls -ld /srv/data

echo "== STEP 7: set up xfs project quota for datauser at 100MB =="
PROJID=1001
grep -q "^datauser:" /etc/projid 2>/dev/null || echo "datauser:$PROJID" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/projid
grep -q "^/srv/data" /etc/projects 2>/dev/null || echo "$PROJID:/srv/data" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/projects

sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c "project -s datauser" /srv/data
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c "limit -p bhard=100m datauser" /srv/data

echo "== STEP 8: verify quota report =="
sudo -n xfs_quota -x -c "report -p -h" /srv/data
